title: Japan's government decides to reduce consumption tax to 1% for food and prepares bill
summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pushes the measure to ease the tax burden, although discrepancies persist in the national committee and with the opposition.

title: Famous Japanese writer Keigo Higashino dies at 68
summary: Author of successful mystery novels such as 'The Devotion of Suspect X', his death triggers an avalanche of tributes from colleagues, actors, and publishers in Japan and Taiwan.

title: Japan advances protection of voice against unauthorized uses, including sexual deepfakes
summary: A Ministry of Justice committee presents guidelines that classify the generation of synthetic voices without permission as a crime, covering fake pornography.

title: Fire in a house in Imari (Saga) causes death of four people, two of them children
summary: The fire started on the ground floor and spread quickly, engulfing the home where a family lived.

title: Japanese state ordered to pay compensation in Matsuhashi case after 41 years of litigation
summary: The court recognizes that the police hid evidence and forced confessions, considering the arrest and judicial process illegal.

title: Japan Coast Guard raids Doshisha institute over helicopter accident in Okinawa
summary: The raid is carried out after a criminal complaint by the family of a victim of a Self-Defense Forces helicopter accident at Futenma base.

title: National minimum wage in Japan could be set at around 1,100 yen per hour
summary: The advisory committee of the Ministry of Health continues negotiations without reaching an agreement, postponing the decision to the next session.

title: Liberal Democratic Party proposes law to punish foreign interference in Japan
summary: The initiative seeks to strengthen national intelligence capability and establish criminal sanctions against interference by foreign powers.

title: Semifinals of the Ryuo shogi tournament define title contenders
summary: In high-level games, shogi masters compete for a place in the final, with detailed analysis of strategies.

title: Prime Minister Takaichi holds press conference after closing of Special Diet
summary: The leader stated that he has no 'points of self-criticism' and reiterated his commitment to economic and security policies.

title: Prime Minister Takaichi's approval drops sharply, according to polls
summary: Political analysts question the government's communication strategy, while the prime minister admits his bewilderment at the causes of the decline.

title: Japan pressures Apple and Google to relax rules for their app stores
summary: The Fair Trade Commission confirms that the tech companies have agreed to allow developers to use alternative payment systems.

title: Taiwan honors Japanese politician Hirofumi Furuya for strengthening bilateral relations
summary: The President of Taiwan presents the medal to the president of the Japan-Taiwan Parliamentary Friendship Association in recognition of his work.

title: Japan and United States address situation in Strait of Hormuz from different fronts
summary: Japan's Defense Minister considers attending an international meeting on security in the area, while a US commander recommends ending the bombings due to their limited effectiveness.
